fields.description: The deployment this person is assigned to. Set once — to move somebody, withdraw this and raise another.
fields.label: Deployment

fields.description: Who is assigned. Set once, because this record holds their own answer.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: The exact terms this person was asked to accept, copied when the assignment was raised. A later amendment does not change it.
fields.label: Terms of Reference

fields.description: Where the work happens, copied from the deployment.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: What this person's deployment has come to. The first five are the question and the answer; Expired is a question nobody answered in time; Participated, Partial Attendance and No Show are what actually happened; Replaced is somebody else going instead, with the original kept.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Assigned
Pending
Accepted
Declined
Withdrawn
Expired
Participated
Partial Attendance
No Show
Replaced

fields.description: What this person is being asked to do, if it differs from everybody else.
fields.label: Assignment Title

fields.description: What this person does on the deployment. A deployment has at most one leader.
fields.label: Role

fields.description: Who this person reports to on the deployment. Somebody on the same roster.
fields.label: Supervisor

fields.description: When this person's own deployment begins. Copied from the deployment, and editable if they join for part of it.
fields.label: Starts

fields.description: When this person's own deployment ends. Never earlier than their start date.
fields.label: Ends

fields.description: When they were asked. Blank when a coordinator placed them directly.
fields.label: Asked On

fields.description: When the question stops standing. An unanswered invitation past this is Expired, which frees the place without pretending the person said no.
fields.label: Answer By

fields.description: When they answered.
fields.label: Answered On

fields.description: What the volunteer said when they answered, in their own words.
fields.label: Their Note

fields.description: Why they cannot go. Their own words, kept so nobody has to guess.
fields.label: Reason For Declining

fields.description: The day they actually joined, which may differ from the planned start.
fields.label: Joined On

fields.description: The day they left, where that is earlier than the end.
fields.label: Left On

fields.description: Anything about how this person's deployment went.
fields.label: Participation Notes

fields.description: When this person completed the briefing. Blank means they have not.
fields.label: Briefed On

fields.description: When they acknowledged the safety brief. A fact recorded, never a gate: refusing to deploy somebody is a coordinator's decision, not a field's.
fields.label: Safety Acknowledged On

fields.description: Hours a coordinator has verified for this deployment. Separate from the volunteer's own time logs, which are their account of it.
fields.label: Verified Hours

fields.description: The assignment this one takes over from. The original is kept exactly as it was.
fields.label: Replaces

fields.description: Who went instead.
fields.label: Replaced By

fields.description: The manager who authorised the swap.
fields.label: Authorised By

fields.description: The coordinator's note on this assignment: why this person, what they bring, what was agreed.
fields.label: Notes
